The '''Flotation Shelter''' was a model of [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] survival raft manufactured by [[Valerenn Environmentals]]. Designed to keep the crew of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] alive in the event of a [[Water/Legends|water]] landing, the Flotation Shelter contained enough supplies to support two people for at least two [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]]. The shelter inflated, with support struts forming a [[di-chrome]] shelter. Supplies included a [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] with a range of four [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]], two weeks [[Ration pack/Legends|rations]], a [[Glowrod/Legends|glowrod]], six [[Meter/Legends|meters]] of [[Syntherope/Legends|syntherope]], two [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]], and a large container of fresh water.<ref name="PSG" />
